reason: Provides definitions and methods of parasite and disease control in livestock production.

tasks.task: Explain various methods of parasite and disease control in livestock production.

subtasks.text: Explain hoof trimming as a method to control hoof rot diseases.
Explain pasture management as a method to control parasites and describe the use of paddocks.
Highlight the method of deworming and the tool used to administer dewormers.
Describe the process of dipping to control ecto parasites and the chemicals used.
Describe tail docking as a practice to control blue fly infestation.
Describe dust bathing and the importance of providing ash pits for livestock.
Outline the process of vaccination and the different methods of administration.
Describe the properties of a good vaccine and the types of vaccines discussed in the lesson.
